top_signals.title: Paramount’s $49 Billion Debt Sale to Kick Off After Lawsuits End
top_signals.summary: Bankers are reaching out to investors ahead of the sale of $49 billion in financing backing Paramount Skydance Corp.’s takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery Inc., after the company settled a series of lawsuits that had held up the $110 billion acquisition.

top_signals.title: Europeans are doing more physical activity, new Eurobarometer shows
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 22 Sep 2026 Today, on the eve of the European Week of Sport 2026, the European Commission published the sixth Eurobarometer on sport and physical activity. The survey shows an increase in physical activity levels across the European Union compared to the last survey published in 2022.
